jobs.description_text: About this role: Our Engineering organization owns the software that makes our marketplace work. Our job is to make sure the data is there, it's right, and people can find it and query it without having to think about the plumbing underneath. We are hiring a Staff Engineer to own that plumbing. jobs.description_text: P-1096 At Databricks, we run the world's largest AI platform. We believe the next breakthroughs will come from models trained on domain-specific enterprise data, not from bigger general-purpose models alone. That's why we built AI Runtime , a serverless product that makes GPU training of any size feel simple, so companies can train their own models the way frontier labs do. Customers across industries train on it, right next to the enterprise data already in Databricks. Among them are Rivian in automotive, Robinhood in fintech, and Merck, which builds foundation models for drug discovery. Our own AI researchers use it to post-train models with hundreds of billions to nearly a trillion parameters. It takes a lot of engineering to make that work, and we've written about it on our blog: how we keep GPUs reliable , make training fault-tolerant , and speed up fine-tuning with fused kernels and smart sequence packing. AI agents now launch experiments too, and on our research team they've already increased training jobs 8x . As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you'll work on the systems behind all of this, solving the hardest technical problems and shaping where AI Runtime goes next. As a Customer Enablement Specialist at Constant Contact, you have the opportunity to deliver exceptional customer experiences to help us achieve outstanding customer retention, increased usage, and revenue expansion targets in the APAC region. This is a high-impact, hybrid role designed for a professional who thrives on variety - balancing technical support with proactive onboarding sessions. Serving our APAC region, you will act as a subject matter expert across our marketing enablement software suites, ensuring our customers — from agile SMBs to highly regulated government and finance entities — maximize the value of our platforms. Your mission is to drive activation, reduce churn, and turn complex technical challenges into seamless growth opportunities for our clients. You’ll be measured based on providing positive outcomes such as CSAT, retention, lifetime value, NPS and reviews. This is a hybrid role based in our Brisbane office, primarily serving our APAC customer base. Drive Customer Enablement & Onboarding Lead high-touch "success sessions" and platform walkthroughs for new customers to ensure high activation rates and optimal account configuration. jobs.title: Digital Customer Success Specialist - Pendo
jobs.description_text: Do you love a challenge? Are you passionate about using technology and in-product messaging to solve customer problems? This may be the role for you. The Digital Success team has an opening for a Digital Customer Success Specialist to help revolutionize how we guide, engage, and deliver value to our customers, playing an important role in the future success of the company. The ideal candidate will have a deep appreciation for the customer lifecycle and strong technical skills, including JavaScript, HTML/CSS, API integrations, and event tracking. You should be self-directed, a creative problem solver, and able to adjust to a fast-paced environment. This position bridges the gap between our Customer Success strategy, product design, and technical data infrastructure. What you’ll do You’ll work closely with Product, UX, Customer Support, Marketing, and Sales: Understand business stakeholders’ strategic vision and priorities for customer onboarding, feature adoption, and retention messaging. Manage relationships and expectations related to day-to-day project delivery. Gather detailed requirements for building in-product guides and messages that support customers throughout their lifecycle. Establish guide frequency rules, manage visual governance, and recommend next steps when stakeholder requests compete.
